name: Fluted Marble Side Table
description: A monolithic side table crafted from what appears to be burgundy marble with prominent white veining. The table features a distinctive fluted or scalloped cylindrical body, with both the top and base edges mirroring this organic, curved profile. The surface is polished, highlighting the natural patterns and rich color of the stone. Its robust, sculptural form suggests it functions as a decorative and functional accent piece.

name: Modern Solid Walnut Table with Sculptural Legs
description: A modern rectangular dining table crafted from solid walnut wood. The table features a tabletop composed of multiple planks, with a subtle seam suggesting potential modularity or extension. Its most distinctive feature is the sculptural leg design, where the thick, curved legs are seamlessly integrated into the underside of the tabletop, creating a fluid, contemporary aesthetic. The natural wood grain is prominent, and the overall design is minimalist yet robust.

name: Ornate East Asian Carved Drum Coffee Table with Mother-of-Pearl Inlay
description: A low, round table featuring a deeply carved, openwork drum-shaped base with intricate floral motifs, and a dark, intricately inlaid tabletop. The tabletop has a slightly raised, tray-like edge.

name: Dark Wood Turned Pedestal Accent Table with Black Stone Top
description: A tall, slender accent table featuring a round black stone top and a dark-stained, turned wood pedestal base. The base is composed of several stacked, bulbous and disc-shaped elements, leading down to a round, stepped foot.

name: Modern Walnut Pedestal Side Table
description: A modern, round wooden side table featuring a sculptural pedestal base in a dark walnut finish. The design is minimalist and contemporary.

name: Contemporary Walnut Square Pedestal Dining Table
description: A contemporary square dining table featuring a walnut wood top with a distinctive veneer pattern and a central pedestal base, resting on a round metal disc.

name: Round Fluted Wood Accent Table
description: A small, round accent table featuring a flat, light wood top with a subtle grain pattern. The table's distinctive base is cylindrical, constructed from numerous vertical, slender wooden dowels or slats, creating a prominent fluted or reeded texture. The entire piece is finished in a natural, light wood tone.

name: Oval Travertine Coffee Table with Sculptural Walnut Base
description: An oval coffee table featuring a light-colored travertine stone top and two sculptural, dark-stained wooden bases. The bases are thick and arched, supporting the substantial stone slab.

name: Modern Round Pedestal Dining Table
description: A modern round dining table featuring a sleek, monochromatic design with a circular tabletop supported by a single, wide conical pedestal base, all finished in a matte beige color.

name: Rectangular Dark Wood Coffee Table with Lower Shelf and Brass Accented Legs
description: A rectangular coffee table constructed from dark-stained wood, featuring a solid top surface, an integrated lower shelf for storage, and four tapered block legs adorned with polished brass caps at the base.

name: Sculptural Wood Pedestal Dining Table
description: A contemporary round dining table featuring a rich, dark wood finish on both its circular top and its distinctive sculptural pedestal base. The base is composed of two interweaving, curved wood elements that provide stability and a modern aesthetic.

name: Dark Wood Round Coffee Table with Stacked Cylindrical Legs
description: A dark-stained wooden round table featuring a tray-like top with a slightly raised edge. The table is supported by numerous short, thick legs, each constructed from multiple stacked cylindrical wood sections, giving a textured, fluted appearance. The legs are symmetrically distributed around the perimeter of the circular top.

name: Modern Pedestal Accent Table
description: A modern pedestal accent table featuring a round top with a distinctive swirled pattern, supported by a slender central stem, and anchored by a complementary round, flared base. The base and stem exhibit a rich bronze-toned metallic finish, contrasting with the lighter, possibly stone-look or composite material of the tabletop.

name: Contemporary Square Two-Tiered Coffee Table with Glass Top
description: A contemporary square coffee table featuring a two-tiered design. The top surface is clear glass, framed by a dark, possibly black-stained wood with gently rounded corners. Below this, a solid dark wood shelf, matching the top frame's finish and rounded corners, serves as the lower tier. The structure is supported by slender, dark-finished metal legs that elegantly connect the upper frame and lower shelf, extending to the floor.

name: Oriental Rosewood Display Stand
description: A low-profile, circular display stand or pedestal table crafted from dark wood, likely rosewood or mahogany. It features an inset top panel, a curved apron, and four short, thick legs with a slightly splayed design, reflecting traditional East Asian furniture aesthetics. The wood has a rich, reddish-brown hue and a smooth, polished finish.

name: Round Slatted Wooden Folding Outdoor Table
description: A round, slatted wooden table designed with a folding X-frame base, suitable for outdoor use. The tabletop features an octagonal outer rim with horizontally aligned slats in the center. The wood has a warm, reddish-brown hue, indicating it is likely a weather-resistant timber like acacia or teak. Its folding mechanism allows for compact storage and portability.

name: Modern Rectangular Extendable Dining Table
description: A modern, rectangular dining table featuring a dark, possibly extendable, tabletop and distinctive angled, tapered legs. The table exhibits a minimalist design with clean lines and a dark wood finish.

name: Rectangular Labradorite and Concrete Coffee Table
description: A contemporary rectangular coffee table featuring a striking dark labradorite stone top with iridescent blue, green, and gold flecks, supported by two robust, rectangular concrete pedestal legs. The table exhibits a minimalist and brutalist aesthetic, highlighting the natural beauty and raw texture of its materials. The edges of the tabletop are gently rounded.

name: Round Two-Drawer Wood Nightstand with Nailhead Trim
description: A round, barrel-shaped nightstand featuring two drawers, crafted from wood with a warm, rich brown finish. It is intricately detailed with bands of brass nailhead trim along the top, mid-section, and base. Each drawer is fitted with a singular, elongated brushed metal pull handle.

name: Gustavian White Oval Extendable Dining Table
description: A white, oval-shaped dining table featuring an extendable top, characteristic of the Gustavian or Neoclassical design periods. The table is supported by four fluted and tapered legs, with a carved rosette motif on the apron below the tabletop. Its monochromatic white finish highlights the sculpted details.

name: White French Provincial Oval Extension Dining Table
description: An oval extension dining table painted in a matte white finish. The tabletop has a visible seam, indicating it can be extended. It stands on four turned and fluted legs, which are adorned with carved details, and the table's apron features subtle decorative carvings at the corners.

name: Transitional Washed Oak Nightstand
description: A rectangular nightstand crafted from light-colored wood, likely oak, with a washed or natural finish. It features a single top drawer with a bronze-toned metal knob and an open storage cubby beneath it. The cubby includes a semicircular cutout at the back for cable management. The nightstand is designed with a molded top edge and a stepped, molded base, contributing to a transitional or rustic aesthetic.

name: Sculptural Dark-Stained Wood Accent Table
description: A modernist sculptural accent table crafted from dark-stained wood, featuring a stacked design of various geometric forms. The base is a wide, flaring cylinder, topped by a narrower cylindrical segment, then a sphere, and finally a broad, shallow bowl-shaped top surface. The entire piece has a smooth, uniform dark brown to black finish, emphasizing its minimalist and organic aesthetic.

name: Mid-Century Modern Round Accent Table
description: A round accent table constructed from dark brown wood, featuring a distinctive X-shaped base composed of four splayed legs that converge at a central point beneath the tabletop. The tabletop has a visible wood grain and a smooth, slightly beveled edge. The overall design suggests a mid-century modern aesthetic.

name: Modern Round Dining Table with Sculptural Pedestal Base
description: A modern round dining table featuring a natural light-toned wood top and a distinctive dark green sculptural pedestal base.

name: Natural Teak Root Console Table
description: A console table crafted from natural teak root, featuring a live-edge top and an intricate, sculptural base.

name: Live-Edge Wood Slice Accent Table
description: A low, circular table crafted from a thick slice of light-toned wood, featuring natural live edges and visible growth rings on its surface, supported by three short, cylindrical wooden legs.

name: Black Modern Round Accent Table
description: A small, round, black table featuring a minimalist design with a high-gloss finish and three curved support legs.

name: Farmhouse Style Trestle Dining Table
description: A rectangular dining table featuring a dark brown tabletop and a substantial white trestle base, designed in a classic farmhouse aesthetic.

name: Traditional Rectangular Dark Wood Dining Table with Turned Legs
description: A dark stained wooden rectangular dining table featuring a solid top and four robust turned legs, suggesting a traditional or farmhouse aesthetic.

name: Oval Pedestal Coffee Table
description: A modern coffee table featuring an oval tabletop and a singular, flared pedestal base, both constructed from light-toned wood with visible grain.

name: Modern Oval Glass Top Coffee Table with Dual Pedestal Bases
description: A modern oval coffee table with a smoked glass top supported by two distinct, sculptural metal pedestal bases with a textured, antiqued finish.

name: Sculptural Concrete Pedestal Accent Table
description: A gray, textured concrete pedestal table with a sculptural base composed of stacked, rounded forms and a flat circular top.

name: Scalloped Oak Round Dining Table
description: A light natural oak wood round table featuring a distinctive scalloped apron and four tapered cylindrical legs.

name: Industrial Style Sofa Side Table
description: A tall, narrow rectangular table featuring a distressed wood-look top and a minimalist black metal frame, designed to slide over furniture.

name: Contemporary Dark Wood Desk with Integrated Drawers and Chrome U-Legs
description: A sleek, contemporary desk featuring a dark-stained wooden top with gently rounded edges and subtly integrated handleless drawers. It is supported by two polished chrome-plated steel U-shaped legs, creating a minimalist and functional design.

name: Dark Wood Rectangular Coffee Table with Two Storage Drawers
description: A rectangular, dark brown wooden coffee table featuring two integrated storage drawers and a recessed panel tabletop, supported by sturdy block legs.

name: Round Marble-Top Pedestal Coffee Table
description: A contemporary round coffee table featuring a white marble top, a black metal pedestal base, and a brass accent ring.

name: Ornate Baroque Style Marble Top Coffee Table
description: A rectangular coffee table featuring a white marble top and a highly ornate, carved wooden base with cabriole legs, finished in a bronze or antique gold tone.

name: Contemporary Walnut and Onyx Console Desk
description: A sophisticated console desk featuring a polished dark wood top with rounded ends, supported by two substantial curved pedestals made of banded light-colored stone, likely onyx. The design combines rich materials and a sleek, contemporary form.

name: Industrial Style Round Accent Table
description: A compact, round accent table featuring a wood-look top with visible plank details and a square-shaped black metal frame base.

name: Modern Round Wood Top Side Table with Conical Base
description: A modern side table featuring a round, light-toned wooden top and a contrasting matte black conical base. The table exhibits a minimalist design, with the circular top slightly overhanging the tapering base. The wood grain of the top is visible, suggesting a natural finish, while the base appears to be a solid, stable structure with a smooth, dark surface.

name: Two-Tiered Round Glass and Wood Coffee Table with Brass Frame
description: A two-tiered round coffee table featuring a dark, possibly smoked, glass top and a wooden lower shelf, supported by a polished brass-toned metal frame with four slender legs.

name: Brushed Bronze Curved Tiered Coffee Table
description: A modern, sculptural coffee table featuring a unique two-tiered design composed of interlocking curved, half-moon shapes. The table is crafted from brushed metal with a patinated bronze finish, giving it a dark, muted greenish-brown color with visible striations. Its low profile and smooth, continuous surfaces create a sophisticated and artistic aesthetic.

name: Minimalist Frosted Acrylic and Wood Coffee Table
description: A minimalist coffee table featuring a rectangular top composed of multiple individual frosted acrylic slats, supported by four substantial rectangular wooden legs. The design emphasizes lightness and transparency.

name: Pebble-Shaped Light Wood Coffee Table
description: A low-profile table made of light wood, featuring an irregular, organic pebble-shaped tabletop and four round, tapered, and slightly splayed legs.

name: Concrete Round Pedestal Accent Table
description: A small, round table with a thick, fluted pedestal base, constructed from a textured concrete or cast stone material in a light gray hue.

name: Rustic Light Wood Extension Dining Table with Trestle Base
description: A rectangular dining table featuring a light, distressed wood finish and a robust trestle base. The tabletop is comprised of three segments, indicating the presence of two extension leaves that allow the table to expand in length. The base consists of two X-shaped supports connected by a central stretcher bar, resting on broad, stepped feet. The overall aesthetic is rustic or farmhouse-inspired.

name: Scalloped Grasscloth Console Table
description: A contemporary half-round console table, entirely wrapped in a natural light beige grasscloth or raffia material. The design features a distinctive scalloped apron that flows into two outer legs and a central T-shaped support leg, creating an organic and elegant silhouette.

name: Contemporary Side Table with Integrated LED Lighting
description: A contemporary accent table featuring a circular black glass top supported by a minimalist dark-finished metal frame. The frame extends downwards to secure a cylindrical base made of a frosted, translucent material, which illuminates from within, suggesting integrated LED lighting. The overall aesthetic is modern and sleek, combining a functional surface with an ambient light source.

name: Two-Drawer Nightstand with Lower Shelf
description: A contemporary nightstand featuring two storage drawers and an open lower shelf, all finished in a muted olive green color. It stands on four tapered legs and is equipped with simple silver-finished knob pulls.

name: Two-Tone Nightstand with Drawer and Cabinet
description: A compact, two-tone storage unit featuring a top drawer and a lower double-door cabinet, accented with black bar handles. The top surface has a light wood finish, while the body is off-white with vertical panel detailing on the cabinet doors. It rests on small, black block feet.

name: Contemporary Square Coffee Table with Brass Trim
description: A low-profile, square coffee table featuring a dark, possibly glass or stone, top surface. The top is framed by a brass-toned metal border that forms the side panels of the table. It rests on a slightly recessed, dark plinth base, giving it a minimalist and modern appearance.

name: Marble Three-Legged Side Table
description: A small, round side table constructed entirely from variegated green and brown marble. It features a circular tabletop supported by three thick, cylindrical legs, showcasing natural veining and color variations.

name: Rectangular Extendable Wooden Dining Table with Rounded Corners
description: A rectangular dining table crafted from wood, featuring a medium brown finish with visible grain. The tabletop has subtly rounded corners and a distinct double-edged profile. Visible seams indicate an integrated extension mechanism, suggesting it can accommodate one or more leaves. The table is supported by four tapered, round legs.

name: Contemporary Dark Wood Pedestal Side Table
description: A contemporary small round table featuring a dark wood finish. The tabletop is perfectly circular, resting on a distinct pedestal base. The base consists of a central cylindrical column that subtly transitions into a bulbous, turned element, supported by a flat, circular foot that mirrors the shape of the tabletop. The design is minimalist and modern, emphasizing clean lines and the natural grain of the wood.

name: Traditional Mahogany Pedestal Accent Table with Drawer
description: A dark brown wooden pedestal accent table, featuring a square top with a small drawer, a turned central column, and three curved cabriole legs. A dark, distressed ceramic vase containing bare branches rests on top of the table.

name: Natural Pine Single Drop-Down Door Nightstand
description: A compact, natural pine nightstand or small cabinet featuring a single storage compartment accessed via a front panel with a circular cutout acting as a handle. Its construction consists of thick, light-colored wooden planks with visible grain, forming a rectangular top, solid side panels that also serve as legs, and a recessed base.

name: Round Dining Table with Sculptural Wood Base
description: A contemporary round dining table featuring a dark, sleek tabletop and a sculptural pedestal base made of dark stained wood. The base consists of multiple curved panels that converge at the center, creating a visually striking and stable support structure. The visible wood grain on the base adds texture, contrasting with the smooth surface of the top. The overall aesthetic is modern and elegant.

name: Modern Wood Conference Table
description: A rectangular conference table crafted from wood or wood-look material, featuring a light to medium brown finish with a visible grain pattern. The tabletop is thick with gently rounded corners. It is supported by two solid, rectangular panel legs connected by a central modesty panel or support beam, creating a sturdy and minimalist design.

name: Contemporary Rectangular Panel-Leg Table
description: A contemporary rectangular table featuring a light wood grain finish. The tabletop has subtly rounded corners, giving it a soft, modern aesthetic. It is supported by two solid, thick panel legs, which are connected by a recessed modesty panel that runs almost the full length of the table, creating a robust and unified base structure. The overall design is minimalist and functional.

name: Modern Sculptural Walnut Accent Table
description: A small, dark brown, wooden table with a rectangular top and a sculptural base. The base consists of three rounded, curved legs that merge at the center and support the tabletop. A small, conical, tapered element protrudes upwards from the center of the tabletop. The entire piece appears to be made of solid wood, likely walnut, with a smooth, matte finish. Its design is very modern and organic.

name: Distressed Whitewashed Wood Coffee Table with Turned Legs
description: An elongated coffee table featuring a distinctive scalloped tabletop made from distressed, whitewashed wood. It is supported by four turned legs connected by a central stretcher, all finished to match the tabletop in a light, aged appearance.

name: Contemporary Carved Wood and Marble Nightstand
description: A square, pedestal-shaped nightstand or side table featuring a dark wood body with a distinctive wavy, carved texture on all visible sides. It is topped with a square slab of variegated green marble. Horizontal lines on the facade suggest integrated storage, likely drawers.

name: Solid Wood Console Table with Pedestal Base
description: A contemporary console table crafted from solid, light-toned wood, featuring a rectangular top and a single, sculptural pedestal base with an undulating texture.

name: Modern Round Slatted Coffee Table
description: A low-profile, modern round coffee table featuring a dark gray slatted top and three robust, angled block legs. The design is minimalist and contemporary.

name: Solid Wood Pedestal Side Tables Set
description: A set of two solid wood tables, each featuring a round tabletop and a conical pedestal base. One table is taller and has a smaller diameter top, while the other is shorter with a larger diameter top. Both exhibit a rich, reddish-brown wood grain.

name: Modern Collaborative Office Table with Integrated Power Modules
description: A long, modern conference table with a light-toned wood tabletop and robust, angular dark metal bases. The tabletop features two integrated black power/data modules, indicating its suitability for collaborative work environments.

name: Modern Oak and Acrylic Console Table
description: A modern console table featuring a thick, rectangular solid oak wood top with visible grain, supported by two clear acrylic panel legs. The wooden top is affixed to the acrylic legs using polished metal brackets, creating a minimalist and floating appearance. The table is long and narrow, designed to be placed against a wall.

name: Modern Scalloped Oak Two-Drawer Desk
description: A contemporary desk crafted from light oak wood, featuring a rectangular top, two integrated drawers with a distinctive scalloped edge along the bottom, and panel legs with a connecting stretcher bar.

name: Oval Marble Top Walnut Console Table
description: A contemporary console table featuring a long, oval-shaped top made of brown veined marble, resting on a solid dark walnut wood base. The base consists of two thick, rectangular slab legs connected by a horizontal stretcher that integrates a single, shallow drawer.

name: Organic Shaped Brutalist Textured Brass Coffee Table
description: A striking coffee table featuring an organically shaped, thick brass tabletop with a deeply textured surface resembling concentric tree rings or water ripples. The heavy brass top rests on four short, recessed, rectangular block legs, likely made of dark-finished metal or wood, providing a low-profile and stable base. The table's design exudes a Brutalist aesthetic combined with natural, organic forms.

name: Modern Natural Wood Two-Drawer Nightstand with Wavy Fronts and Spherical Feet
description: A modern nightstand crafted from natural light-toned wood, featuring a rectangular body with two stacked drawers. The drawer fronts are distinguished by a playful, wave-like or scalloped cut-out along their bottom edge, acting as integrated pulls. The entire unit rests on four prominent spherical wooden feet, which add a whimsical and sturdy base.

name: Modern Asymmetrical Executive Desk
description: A modern executive desk featuring a rectangular top crafted from medium-toned wood, appearing to float above its base. The base is asymmetrical, composed of a dark brown, solid-sided storage unit on the left and a distinctive angled panel leg on the right. An integrated modesty panel or structural beam in a matching medium wood tone connects the two support elements beneath the tabletop, adding visual interest and stability. The design emphasizes clean lines and contrasting wood finishes.

name: Square Wooden Coffee Table with Integrated Drawers
description: A square, low-profile coffee table made of dark brown wood, featuring two integrated drawers and a minimalist, sturdy design. The top surface is flat, showing natural wood grain.

name: Modern Console Table with Colorful Rope Base
description: A modern console table featuring a live-edge style wooden top and a base made from numerous colorful, intertwined rope-like elements. These elements create an hourglass-like silhouette, connecting the top to a rectangular wooden plinth at the bottom. The ropes are vibrant in colors like red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple, providing a striking contrast to the natural wood grain.

name: Plum Lacquer Coffee Table with Integrated Marble Top and Sculptural Pedestal Bases
description: A contemporary coffee table featuring a rectangular top with rounded corners, finished in a high-gloss plum lacquer. The tabletop includes an integrated, recessed rectangular panel of white marble with reddish-brown veining. The table is supported by two large, sculptural, bulbous pedestal bases, also finished in the matching plum lacquer, giving it a distinctive and bold aesthetic.

name: Neoclassical Marble Pedestal Accent Table
description: A refined round pedestal table featuring a polished marble top, an ornate bronze or brass frieze around the apron, and an elegant off-white fluted columnar base resting on a tiered octagonal plinth.

name: Modern White Pedestal Side Table
description: A minimalist white round side table featuring a thick, smooth tabletop supported by a distinctive pedestal base composed of four inward-sloping panels.

name: Modern Rectangular Solid Oak Dining Table with Spider Base
description: A modern rectangular dining table featuring a solid oak wood top with natural grain patterns and a distinct black powder-coated metal spider-leg base. The design is contemporary, emphasizing both natural materials and geometric structure.

name: Modern Sculptural Glass Coffee Table
description: A modern coffee table featuring a clear, circular glass top supported by a unique, sculptural white base. The base consists of flowing, curvilinear forms that interlock and rise to meet the glass, creating an artistic and contemporary aesthetic.

name: Modern Glass Top Coffee Table with Cylindrical Legs
description: A modern rectangular coffee table featuring a clear glass top with softly rounded corners. The base is made of a dark burgundy-colored material, likely wood, and consists of four substantial cylindrical legs connected by a central horizontal stretcher.

name: Round Fluted Wood Side Table
description: A round side table featuring a dark brown wood finish. It has a circular tabletop with a subtle raised edge and a cylindrical pedestal base with vertical fluting, providing a textured appearance.

name: Modern Rectangular Marble Dining Table
description: A modern rectangular dining table featuring a white marble top with prominent purplish-brown veining, supported by two solid, dark brown cylindrical wood bases. The table top has softly rounded corners, contributing to its sleek and contemporary aesthetic. The surface of the marble is highly polished, reflecting light, and the overall design is minimalist, emphasizing the natural beauty of the materials.

name: Rectangular Art Deco Inspired Lacquered Dining Table
description: A long, rectangular dining table featuring a dark, possibly navy blue or black, lacquered finish. The tabletop has a subtle beveled edge and is adorned with slim brass inlays running along its length and partially down the sides, intersecting the table's supports. It is supported by two substantial, tapered pedestal bases, also finished in the same dark lacquer, with vertical brass accents integrated into their design. The overall aesthetic is sleek, luxurious, and reminiscent of Art Deco design.

name: Two-Tone Concrete-Effect Modular Home Office Unit with Integrated Desk
description: A comprehensive modular home office unit featuring a two-tone design with light and dark gray concrete-effect finishes. It includes wall-mounted upper cabinets, lower base units with drawers and doors, and integrated desk surfaces, all fitted with black bar pulls.

name: Artisan Pedestal Side Table with Perforated Top
description: A dark, round table with a perforated sunburst pattern on its surface, centered by a small, domed wooden element. It stands on a segmented, stacked wooden pedestal base in a rich brown hue, supported by a flat, dark circular foot.

name: Live Edge Wood Coffee Table
description: A rectangular coffee table featuring a live-edge wood slab top, supported by two pairs of short, rectangular block legs. The wood exhibits a light to medium brown hue with natural, swirling grain patterns.

name: Modern Rounded Oak Coffee Table with Integrated Drawers
description: A modern, rectangular coffee table crafted from oak wood, featuring softly rounded edges and two integrated, flush-front drawers. The design incorporates a seamless waterfall effect where the side panels flow into the top surface.

name: Two-Tier Wrought Iron Console Table with Light Wood Shelves
description: A rectangular, two-tiered console table featuring a dark, possibly wrought iron frame with X-shaped side supports and horizontal crossbars. The two shelves are made of light-colored wood or laminate with a subtle grain pattern. A decorative, knob-like element adorns the central horizontal support between the X-shaped frames.

name: Cylindrical Panel-Faced Nightstand
description: A light-colored wooden nightstand with a distinctive cylindrical form factor. It features two storage drawers, each with a small brass knob pull. The body of the nightstand is visually textured with vertical wood paneling, segmented horizontally into three tiers. The circular top surface is flat, and the unit stands on a slightly recessed, solid circular plinth base, all crafted from wood with visible grain.

name: Modern Extendable Dining Table with Faux Marble Top and Pedestal Base
description: A modern extendable dining table featuring a white faux marble top with a grey vein pattern, supported by a unique pedestal base composed of angled, light wood-look panels accented with black strips. The table's design suggests contemporary aesthetics and practical functionality.

name: Faceted Brass Octagonal Coffee Table
description: An octagonal coffee table featuring a substantial, drum-shaped body constructed from multiple faceted brass panels. The top surface is flat and octagonal, mirroring the base's geometry. The brass has a warm, aged, or patinated finish, giving it a rich, golden-brown hue with subtle variations in tone. The overall design is sculptural and robust, characterized by clean lines and a low profile.

name: Modern Wooden Nightstand with Integrated Lighting
description: A compact, square-shaped wooden nightstand with rounded corners and a minimalist design. It features two floating drawers with integrated LED lighting along the top edge, creating a warm glow. The lower section includes an open shelf, also illuminated from beneath, and appears to rest on a recessed base. The visible wood grain gives it a natural yet refined aesthetic.

name: Rustic Solid Wood Trestle Dining Table
description: A long, rectangular dining table constructed from solid wood, featuring a rustic aesthetic. The tabletop is composed of multiple planks, showcasing natural wood grain and texture. It is supported by two sturdy trestle bases, each with a wide, footed base, connected by a prominent horizontal stretcher bar for stability. The overall design emphasizes a robust, natural, and timeless appeal.

name: Round Natural Wood Tray Coffee Table
description: A modern round coffee table crafted from light-toned natural wood, featuring a distinctive tray-style top with a raised rim. The top includes two subtle cut-outs on opposing sides, adding a design detail and potentially aiding in lifting or handling. The table stands on four straight, splayed wooden legs, contributing to its stable and contemporary Scandinavian aesthetic. The overall finish appears smooth and matte.

name: Modern Organic Light Oak Coffee Table with Cylindrical Legs
description: A modern coffee table made from light-colored, natural oak wood, featuring a rectangular top with gracefully rounded edges and supported by four thick, cylindrical legs arranged in two distinct pairs.

name: Mixed-Material Sculptural Console Table
description: An exquisite sculptural console table featuring an assemblage of diverse high-quality materials including polished brass, translucent raw-cut quartz, white veined marble, and dark green variegated marble. The elongated rectangular top is segmented, with distinct sections of brass, quartz-like stone (where brass appears to fill natural fissures in a kintsugi-like manner), and white marble. The table is supported by an asymmetric, deconstructed base composed of a large, angular translucent stone block at one end and a sturdy column of dark green marble paired with a lighter beige marble block at the other. A slim, integrated brass shelf is positioned below the tabletop, connecting the disparate support elements and adding both visual interest and subtle utility.

name: White Oval Console Table with Drawer
description: A pristine white console table featuring an elongated oval tabletop. It is supported by four elegantly tapered legs, connected to the apron with a subtle scalloped detail. A single, central drawer with a brass-toned keyhole provides discreet storage. The entire piece is finished in a smooth, uniform white paint.

name: Organic Modern Accent Table
description: A low-profile accent table featuring a distinctive organic, undulating tabletop with soft, rounded edges, supported by three thick, cylindrical legs. The entire piece is rendered in a monochromatic, matte greige finish, embodying a minimalist and sculptural aesthetic.

name: Modern Curved Walnut Nightstand with Drawer
description: A compact, modern nightstand or bedside table crafted from dark-toned wood, featuring smoothly rounded continuous edges, an integrated pull-out drawer, and an open lower storage compartment.

name: Modern Square Slatted Teak Outdoor Dining Table
description: A modern square dining table crafted from light-toned wood, likely teak, designed for outdoor use. It features a slatted tabletop with a defined border and a unique, open-work base composed of vertical and horizontal wooden slats forming a geometric cage-like structure. The table has a clean, contemporary aesthetic.

name: Modern Organic Console Table
description: A modern console table with a distinctive organic-shaped tabletop, supported by two robust, sculptural leg bases. The entire piece is finished in a uniform matte black, revealing subtle wood grain texture.

name: Modern Extendable Dining Table with Starburst Pedestal Base
description: A modern extendable dining table featuring a light-colored, rectangular tabletop with softly rounded edges, supported by a distinctive starburst-style pedestal base composed of multiple intersecting rectangular beams. The table incorporates a hidden extension mechanism, allowing for increased seating capacity. Its neutral color palette and clean lines are characteristic of contemporary design.

name: Modern Round Wood-Top Pedestal Bar Table
description: A modern bar table featuring a round, light wood-grain laminate tabletop supported by a single dark gray cylindrical metal pedestal base. The base is weighted and circular, providing stability. The design is minimalist and functional.

name: Modern Sculptural Walnut Coffee Table
description: A low, rectangular wooden coffee table crafted from dark walnut wood, featuring a tabletop with rounded edges supported by two thick, panel-style legs. Each leg incorporates three nested, semi-circular arched cutouts, giving it a distinctive sculptural and architectural appearance.

name: Modern Metal and Stone Accent Table with Spherical Base
description: A modern accent table featuring a circular, dark-finished metal top with a textured surface, supported by a slender, dark metal stem. The stem is anchored by a large, spherical base made of light-colored stone, possibly marble or concrete. The design is minimalist and sculptural.

name: Sculptural Walnut and Marble Coffee Table
description: A contemporary coffee table featuring a rectangular white marble top with rounded corners, supported by a unique, sculptural dark walnut wood base. The base exhibits organic, flowing lines, creating a dynamic silhouette.

name: Modern Round Marble Top Pedestal Side Table
description: A modern round side table featuring a white marble top with subtle gray veining, supported by a sleek black pedestal base. The tabletop has a thin black rim, complementing the matte black finish of the cylindrical column and wide circular base, which provides stability. The design is minimalist and contemporary.

name: Mid-Century Modern Walnut Accent Side Table
description: A small, three-legged table featuring a rounded triangular top crafted from dark brown walnut wood with prominent grain. The top has a gently curved edge profile. Three slender, tapered, and slightly splayed legs support the top, connecting seamlessly to its underside. The overall design suggests a Mid-Century Modern aesthetic.

name: Ornate Bronze Accent Table with Twisted Column Legs
description: An ornate accent table featuring a round, flat top with a studded edge, supported by four distinctive twisted column legs. The legs converge at an X-shaped cross-stretcher base, adorned with a central brass finial and brass bun feet. The entire piece has a dark metallic, possibly bronze or antique brass, finish.

name: Traditional Dark Wood Square Coffee Table with Turned Legs and Lower Shelf
description: A traditional square coffee table crafted from dark stained wood, featuring a prominent tabletop and a lower storage shelf. The table is supported by four ornate turned legs that taper to small feet, showcasing a classic design aesthetic.

name: Low-Profile Round Pedestal Coffee Table
description: A contemporary low-profile round coffee table featuring a dark stained wood finish. Its substantial circular top rests upon a concealed central pedestal and two smaller, rounded support feet, contributing to its monolithic and grounded appearance.

name: Organic Shape Wood Coffee Table
description: A low-profile coffee table featuring an organic, biomorphic tabletop shape and thick, rounded edges. The table is crafted from wood with a visible grain, finished in a muted gray-brown tone. It is supported by four robust, cylindrical legs that blend seamlessly with the table's overall chunky aesthetic. The design emphasizes natural, fluid lines, giving it a contemporary and sculptural feel.

name: Modern Rounded Oak and Stone Nightstand
description: A compact, modern nightstand or bedside cabinet featuring a light-toned oak wood body. It has a square top with gently rounded corners, appearing to be made of a light stone like travertine. The upper section contains a single drawer or door with a subtle, recessed brass or gold-toned handle. The base is a solid, architectural wooden structure, creating a robust pedestal-like form. The overall aesthetic is minimalist and contemporary.

name: Traditional Oak Trestle Dining Table
description: A traditional rectangular dining table crafted from light-colored wood, likely oak, featuring a trestle base. The tabletop has rounded corners and a smooth, polished finish. The base consists of two turned pedestals, each supported by two splayed, carved legs, all connected by a central horizontal stretcher bar.
